hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.zh: WHO於9/29報告全球去(2025)年累計47個國家報告45萬1,499例病例,其中7,870例死亡,總病例數較2024年下降,惟死亡人數較2024年增加30%,為1999年以來最高之單年死亡數,疫情集中於安哥拉、孟加拉、剛果⺠主共和國、奈及利亞、南蘇丹、蘇丹及葉門等7國(占全球病例數與死亡數約90%),且非洲病例數與死亡數皆上升。WHO於今年重啟預防接種計畫,並表示口服疫苗年產量已提升至8,000萬劑,惟逾1/5死亡病例發生於醫療機構之外,突顯延誤就醫問題嚴重性,呼籲各國應加速投資安全水質與衛生等設施。
hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.en: On 29 September, WHO reported that in 2025, 47 countries cumulatively reported 451,499 cases, including 7,870 deaths. Total cases were lower than in 2024, but deaths rose 30% over 2024, the highest annual death toll since 1999. Cases were concentrated in seven countries (Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen), which together accounted for about 90% of global cases and deaths; cases and deaths both rose in Africa. WHO restarted vaccination programmes this year and stated that annual oral vaccine production has risen to 80 million doses. However, more than one in five deaths occurred outside health facilities, highlighting the serious problem of delayed care-seeking, and WHO called on countries to accelerate investment in safe water and sanitation.

0D0a0Xks_etsZoVfRFRQLw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/27-9/2期間,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增3國共12例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國8例、南蘇丹3例、馬利1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞2 例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦6件 。
0D0a0Xks_etsZoVfRFRQLw.en: The GPEI reported that during 27 August–2 September, cVDPV1 added 1 case in South Sudan; cVDPV2 added 12 cases in three countries: 8 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 3 in South Sudan and 1 in Mali; cVDPV3 added 2 cases in Nigeria. In environmental samples, WPV1 added 6 detections in Pakistan.

_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年7/31累計145國/地區報告19萬683例確定病例,其中529例死亡。 今年7月共計32國家/地區報告1,370例確定病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:0.5%),以馬達加斯加(703例)、安哥拉(138例)、中國(88 例)、剛果⺠主共和國(55例)及肯亞(55例)為多,74.8%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年6月,全球病例數下降12.5%,僅非洲區呈上升趨勢,其餘地區下降;東南亞區及東地中海區則無通報病例。 全球已有68個國家/地區曾通報檢出Clade Ib確定病例,近6週(7/6-8/16)共有22國報告病例,其中15國出現本土社區傳播疫情,分布於非洲6國(馬達加斯加、安哥拉、肯亞、剛果⺠主共和國、南蘇丹、蒲隆地)及歐洲9國(葡萄牙、德國、法國、英國、愛爾蘭、荷蘭、義大利、瑞士及捷克)。 另馬達加斯加自2025年12月起迄今爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情。
_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.en: Globally, since 2022 and as of 31 July this year, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 190,683 confirmed cases, including 529 deaths. In July this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,370 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR 0.5%); the largest numbers were in Madagascar (703), Angola (138), China (88), the DRC (55) and Kenya (55), and 74.8% of cases came from Africa. Compared with June this year, global cases fell by 12.5%; only Africa showed an increase, while other regions declined, and no cases were reported from South-East Asia or the Eastern Mediterranean region. A total of 68 countries and territories have ever reported confirmed clade Ib cases. In the past six weeks (6 July–16 August), 22 countries reported cases, of which 15 have local community transmission: six in Africa (Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the DRC, South Sudan and Burundi) and nine in Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland and Czechia). Madagascar has been experiencing the largest clade Ib outbreak in the world since December 2025.

bEzlW0uCsrcVgjkb1Ij05A.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/6-12期間,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增奈及利亞/索馬利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共15件,分別為巴基斯坦10件、阿富汗5件,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹1件,cVDPV2新增3國共5件,分別為索馬利亞3件、利比亞/奈及利亞各1件,cVDPV3新增奈及利亞1件。
bEzlW0uCsrcVgjkb1Ij05A.en: The GPEI reported that during 6–12 August, cVDPV1 added 1 case in South Sudan, and cVDPV2 added 1 case each in Nigeria and Somalia. In environmental samples, WPV1 added 15 detections in two countries: 10 in Pakistan and 5 in Afghanistan. cVDPV1 added 1 detection in South Sudan; cVDPV2 added 5 detections in three countries: 3 in Somalia, and 1 each in Libya and Nigeria; and cVDPV3 added 1 detection in Nigeria.

y02ozEKU3FeZeldToHWnyA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/9-15期間,WPV1新增阿富汗4例;cVDPV1新增2國共3例,分別為衣索比亞2例、南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增2國共3例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國2例、查德1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共13件,分別為阿富汗12件、巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV1新增馬達加斯加2件。
y02ozEKU3FeZeldToHWnyA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 9–15 July: WPV1 cases increased by 4 in Afghanistan; cVDPV1 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in Ethiopia and 1 in South Sudan; cVDPV2 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Chad; and cVDPV3 cases increased by 1 in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 13 across 2 countries, with 12 in Afghanistan and 1 in Pakistan, and cVDPV1 increased by 2 in Madagascar.

OmZ5GT75Ek_0lYVPu7v9jQ.zh: 一名於剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)從事人道救援工作之美國公⺠確診,個案已於7/13後送至德國醫院治療,目前病況穩定。 美國CDC於7/13宣布,延續針對過去21天內曾停留DRC、烏干達或南蘇丹之外籍人士實施暫停入境措施,目前僅允許該國公⺠、國⺠、特定政府與軍事人員,或經專案核准個案入境。
OmZ5GT75Ek_0lYVPu7v9jQ.en: A US citizen working in humanitarian aid in the DRC was diagnosed with Ebola. After 13 July, the patient was evacuated to a hospital in Germany for treatment, and their condition is currently stable. On 13 July, the US CDC announced that it would extend its entry suspension for foreign nationals who had been in the DRC, Uganda or South Sudan within the past 21 days. Currently, only the country's citizens and nationals, certain government and military personnel, or individuals approved on a case-by-case basis may enter.

lOtCjWUamfIWtrTQg0E4rw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/25-7/1期間,WPV1新增阿富汗1例,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹2例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦6件。
lOtCjWUamfIWtrTQg0E4rw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 25 June–1 July: WPV1 cases increased by 1 in Afghanistan, and cVDPV1 cases increased by 2 in South Sudan. For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 6 in Pakistan.

jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年5/31累計144國/地區報告18萬5,882例確定病例,其中509例死亡。 今年5月共計32國家/地區報告1,142例確定病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加(649例)、中國(89例)、法國(63例)、澳洲(50例)及德國(45例)為高,63.9%的病例來自非洲地區。相較今年4月,西太平洋區及非洲區病例數呈上升趨勢 ,其餘地區疫情則下降,挪威通報首例Ib型病例,另波蘭先前的I型病例確定為Ib型次分支。 非洲地區近6週(5/4-6/14)共計10國報告790例確定病例,其中3 例死亡(CFR 0.45%),以馬達加斯加、肯亞、幾內亞、南蘇丹、喀麥隆及剛果⺠主共和國為高;非洲以外地區,為西班牙與泰國持續報告Ib型社區傳播。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月以來面臨全球最大規模的Ib型疫情,截至今年6/14,累計2,117例確定病例與7例死亡(多為免疫低下者)。疫情已擴及全國60%的行政區(69/115),主要影響15-49 歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(超過7.9萬人施打),惟面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流與醫療量能挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。
jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 31 May this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 185,882 confirmed cases, including 509 deaths. In May this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.3%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (649), China (89), France (63), Australia (50) and Germany (45), and 63.9% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with April this year, case numbers rose in the Western Pacific and African Regions and declined in other regions. Norway reported its first clade Ib case, and Poland's earlier clade I case has been identified as a clade Ib sub-lineage. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (4 May–14 June), 10 countries reported 790 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.45%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar, Kenya, Guinea, South Sudan, Cameroon and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Outside Africa, Spain and Thailand continued to report clade Ib community transmission. Madagascar has faced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 14 June this year, 2,117 confirmed cases and 7 deaths (mostly among immunocompromised people) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 60% of the country's administrative areas (69 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15 to 49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has been rolled out (more than 79,000 people vaccinated), the outbreak remains uncontrolled because of challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics and health system capacity.

L1_GqAcUQggZp6QdSZShdg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,地理擴散至第4個省份上韋萊省(Haut-Uele),一名自伊圖里省移入的病患抵達後死亡 。上韋萊省位於DRC東北部,與南蘇丹及中非共和國接壤且跨境移動頻繁,大幅提升跨國傳播風險,且當地武裝衝突嚴重,阻礙防疫工作,當局已禁止首都金夏沙及多省的大型集會。截至6/27止,DRC累計報告1,274例確定病例與360例死亡;烏干達則報告20例確定病例與2例死亡。
L1_GqAcUQggZp6QdSZShdg.en: The DRC continues to report new cases, and geographic spread has extended to a fourth province, Haut-Uélé, where a patient transferred from Ituri died after arrival. Haut-Uélé is located in the north-east of the DRC, borders South Sudan and the Central African Republic, and has frequent cross-border movement, which substantially raises the risk of transnational spread. Local armed conflict is severe and hinders disease control efforts, and authorities have banned large gatherings in the capital, Kinshasa, and several provinces. As of 27 June, the DRC has reported 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths cumulatively; Uganda has reported 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths.

9kcLAdugkK5hvDJECYo3pw.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,6/25新增48例確定病例,其中11例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(42例)及北基伍省(6例)。迄6/25累計1,203例確定病例(321例死亡、148例康復),致死率26.7%,疫情主要集中在東部伊圖里(1,096例)、北基伍(104例) 及南基伍省(3例)共34個衛生區,接觸者追蹤率約82.8%。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,迄6/27累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、15例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5 例為本土病例。個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關,尚無社區傳播疫情。 WHO非洲區署依據DRC截至6/8的累計598例確定病例數作SEIRD隨機數理模型推估,預測DRC至9/16將達8,210例確定病例(其中1,440例死亡)。推估截至8/12對烏干達造成至少1例境外移入的可能性為94.2%,其次為南蘇丹(可能性69.3%)、盧安達(可能性8.6%)、蒲隆地(可能性2%)。
9kcLAdugkK5hvDJECYo3pw.en: The DRC continues to report new cases. On 25 June, 48 new confirmed cases were added, including 11 deaths, in Ituri Province (42 cases) and North Kivu Province (6). As of 25 June, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,203 (321 deaths, 148 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 26.7%. The outbreak is mainly concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri (1,096 cases), North Kivu (104) and South Kivu (3), across 34 health zones. The contact tracing rate is about 82.8%. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 27 June, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 15 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases. The cases are in the capital, Kampala, and Wakiso District, all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure, and there is no community transmission. The WHO Regional Office for Africa, using a SEIRD stochastic model based on the DRC's cumulative total of 598 confirmed cases as of 8 June, projects that the DRC will reach 8,210 confirmed cases by 16 September, including 1,440 deaths. The model estimates a 94.2% probability that Uganda will have at least one imported case by 12 August, followed by South Sudan (69.3%), Rwanda (8.6%) and Burundi (2%).

RNw-_jMwNJPWhyPylKP8Cg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 5/21-27 期間,WPV1 新增阿富汗 1 例;cVDPV1 新增馬達加斯加/南蘇丹各 1 例;cVDPV2 新增索馬利亞 2 例;cVDPV3 新增奈及利亞 3 例;環境樣本部分,WPV1 新增阿富汗 11 件,cVDPV2 新增索馬利亞 3 件。
RNw-_jMwNJPWhyPylKP8Cg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 21 and 27 May, WPV1 added one case in Afghanistan; cVDPV1 added one case each in Madagascar and South Sudan; cVDPV2 added two cases in Somalia; and cVDPV3 added three cases in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added 11 specimens in Afghanistan and cVDPV2 added three in Somalia.

E5OUYwmPNlbc9R4BBSFotg.zh: WHO 公布全球今年截至 4/26 累計報告 7 萬 9,740 例病例,1,010 例死亡,其中,4 月新增病例數較今年 3 月下降 54%,且較去年同期下降 62%,各國 CFR 介於 0-8.9%。病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞及美洲共 22 個國家,近期新增病例以剛果民主共和國、阿富汗、安哥拉及南蘇丹為多。WHO 評估約有 10 億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
E5OUYwmPNlbc9R4BBSFotg.en: WHO reports that globally, as of 26 April this year, 79,740 cases and 1,010 deaths have been reported cumulatively. New cases in April fell 54% from March this year and 62% from the same period last year. CFR across countries ranges from 0% to 8.9%. Cases are distributed across 22 countries in the Eastern Mediterranean, Africa, South-East Asia and the Americas. Recent new cases are mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan, Angola and South Sudan. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people face infection risk, and the global transmission risk is very high.

TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022 年截至今年4/30 累計144 國/地區報告18 萬4,531例確診病例,其中,至少506例死亡。 非洲地區近6週(4/6-5/17)通報確診病例數最高國家:馬達加斯加(780例)、幾內亞(40例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、肯亞(27例)、賴比瑞亞(17例)。 全球近6週(4/6-5/17)共有19個國家報告 Ib型病毒:   社區傳播共15國:馬達加斯加(780例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、巴基斯坦(29例)、肯亞(27例)、西班牙(18例)、德國(17例)、瑞士(14例)、葛摩/葡萄牙(6例)、斯洛伐克/剛果共和國(4例)、哥倫比亞(3例)、泰國/丹麥(2例)。 與旅遊相關(境外移入)共4 國:美國(5 例)、模里西斯(2 例)、臺灣/愛爾蘭(1例)。
TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 30 April this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 184,531 confirmed cases, of which at least 506 were fatal. In Africa, the countries reporting the most confirmed cases over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May) were Madagascar (780), Guinea (40), South Sudan (37), the DRC (35), Kenya (27) and Liberia (17). Globally, 19 countries have reported clade Ib virus over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May). Community transmission has been reported in 15 countries: Madagascar (780), South Sudan (37), DRC (35), Pakistan (29), Kenya (27), Spain (18), Germany (17), Switzerland (14), Comoros/Portugal (6), Slovakia/Republic of the Congo (4), Colombia (3), and Thailand/Denmark (2). Travel-associated (imported) cases have been reported in four countries: United States (5), Mauritius (2), and Taiwan/Ireland (1).

zJlKmALp4sdLSbjrqo6fAg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/14-20期間,cVDPV1新增南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增奈及利亞/葉門各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV2新增葉門2件。
zJlKmALp4sdLSbjrqo6fAg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 14 and 20 May, cVDPV1 added one case in South Sudan, and cVDPV2 added one case each in Nigeria and Yemen. For environmental samples, WPV1 added one specimen in Pakistan and cVDPV2 added two in Yemen.

QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續擴大,截至5/24累計報告112例確診及11例死亡、906例疑病例及223例疑病例死亡,主要分布於伊圖里省、北基伍省及南基伍省;烏干達迄今累積報告7例確診,其中1例死亡;義大利出現2例疑病例,在烏干達擔任為期三個月的援助工作人員,返回義國後,出現高燒、嘔吐、腹瀉和噁心等疑症狀,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。非洲CDC評估有11個國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、南蘇丹、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、坦尚亞、尚比亞及索馬利亞。
QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情持續擴大,疫情主要分布於DRC伊圖里與北基伍省,兩國截至5/23累計報告91例確診及10例死亡、867例疑病例及204例疑病例死亡,且匡列1,261名接觸者。DRC伊圖里省傳出3名紅十字會志工染病死亡,南基伍省(South Kivu)亦於5/20通報首例28歲死亡確診個案。烏干達迄今累積報告5例確診,其中1例死亡。另南蘇丹澄清其境內疑病例,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。 WHO指出疫情在5/15通報前恐已隱匿傳播數週或數月,導致疫情蔓延至多個省份。非洲CDC評估有10個非洲國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、南蘇丹、坦尚亞及尚比亞。 WHO緊急委員會第一次會議臨時建議,評估剛果民主共和國風險為「非常高」,烏干達及區域風險為「高」,全球風險為「低」。建議疫區國家啟動國家災害或突發事件管理機制,並執行包括加強監測等防控措施;區域層級國家應建立與地方各層級相銜接的國家協調機制制定相關措施;其他國家對來自已記錄到病毒(BDBV)感染地區出現不明原因發熱症狀的旅行者進行檢測、評估、報告及管理,執行公眾之疫情風險溝通等。
sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to expand, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu provinces of the DRC. As of 23 May, the two countries had reported 91 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths, and 1,261 contacts had been listed. In Ituri Province, DRC, three Red Cross volunteers were reported to have died after infection. South Kivu Province reported its first confirmed case, a death in a 28-year-old, on 20 May. Uganda has reported five cumulative confirmed cases, one of which was fatal. South Sudan clarified that a suspected case in its territory tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases there. WHO notes that the outbreak may have spread silently for several weeks or months before it was reported on 15 May, leading to spread across multiple provinces. The Africa CDC assesses that 10 African countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia. The first meeting of the WHO Emergency Committee provisionally assessed the risk as very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and at regional level, and low globally. It recommends that affected countries activate national disaster or emergency management mechanisms and implement control measures, including enhanced surveillance; that countries in the region establish national coordination mechanisms linked to local levels; and that other countries test, assess, report and manage travellers with unexplained fever who have been in areas where Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection has been recorded, and communicate public health risks.

4JYnnMhmWMET4Rx7DVWnyQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情急遽擴大,截至5/20累計報告近600例疑與139死亡病例,南蘇丹亦通報1例疑個案,跨國傳播風險驟升。由於目前DRC面臨武裝衝突、大量人口流離失所,加上檢體運送困難,當局表示可能嚴重低估通報病例數。另烏干達已宣布取消年度大型慶典「殉道者節」。
4JYnnMhmWMET4Rx7DVWnyQ.en: The outbreak in the DRC and Uganda is expanding rapidly: as of 20 May, nearly 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths had been reported cumulatively. South Sudan has also reported one suspected case, and the risk of cross-border spread has sharply increased. Because the DRC is facing armed conflict and mass displacement, and sample transport is difficult, authorities say case numbers may be seriously underreported. Uganda has also announced the cancellation of its annual major celebration, Martyrs' Day.

slRQIQas8Sza4Ku06GGqaA.zh: 南蘇丹東南部東赤道州出現 3 例疑出血熱症狀病例,WHO已派遣調查小組至當地進行疫情調查與控制,目前致病原仍調查中。
slRQIQas8Sza4Ku06GGqaA.en: Three suspected haemorrhagic fever cases have been reported in Eastern Equatoria State in the south-east of South Sudan. WHO has dispatched an investigation team to conduct outbreak investigation and control on the ground. The causative pathogen is still under investigation.

Jn0sgwhXOawvxnGBHLv0KA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 4/9-15 期間,WPV1 新增阿富汗 2 例;cVDPV1 新增南蘇丹 2 例;cVDPV2 新增蘇丹 4 例;環境樣本部分,WPV1 新增巴基斯坦 1 件,cVDPV2 新增 2 國共 3 件,分別為蘇丹 2 件、納米比亞 1 件。
Jn0sgwhXOawvxnGBHLv0KA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 9 and 15 April, WPV1 added two cases in Afghanistan; cVDPV1 added two cases in South Sudan; and cVDPV2 added four cases in Sudan. For environmental samples, WPV1 added one specimen in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added three specimens across two countries: two in Sudan and one in Namibia.

WGBESEL7gduXJsRKPB5NYw.zh: 非洲2025年截至12/21累計報告逾31萬例病例,其中約3,000例死亡,有88%的病患居住在南蘇丹、蘇丹、剛果民主共和國、安哥拉及奈及利亞,非洲CDC提出整合性策略以對抗疫情;另全球每年約有130-400萬人感染,造成2-14萬人死亡。
WGBESEL7gduXJsRKPB5NYw.en: In Africa, cumulative cases in 2025 up to 21 December exceeded 310,000, of which about 3,000 died. 88% of patients lived in South Sudan, Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Angola and Nigeria. The Africa CDC has proposed an integrated strategy to combat the outbreak. Globally, an estimated 1.3–4 million people are infected each year, causing 20,000–140,000 deaths.

ijG8mTyCHDhy1TRAA2bBfA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至8月累計報告逾46萬例,近6,000例死亡,其中,8月新增報告逾5.7萬例,較7月下降16%,各國CFR介於0-9.8%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海、東南亞、美洲、西太平洋共32個國家/地區,以阿富汗、南蘇丹及葉門為多;WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
ijG8mTyCHDhy1TRAA2bBfA.en: WHO reports that globally, as of August this year, more than 460,000 cases and nearly 6,000 deaths have been reported cumulatively. In August, more than 57,000 new cases were reported, 16% lower than in July, with national case fatality rates ranging from 0 to 9.8%. Cases have been distributed across 32 countries and areas in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean, South-East Asia, the Americas and the Western Pacific, mainly in Afghanistan, South Sudan and Yemen. WHO assesses that about one billion people face the risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.

te-55ufcQ2ClxQUbcfUTeA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至7月累計報告約38萬例,4,478例死亡,其中,7月新增報告約6.8萬例、死亡624例,較6月上升14%,各國CFR介於0-11.2%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海、東南亞及美洲共31個國家/地區,以南蘇丹、阿富汗、葉門及剛果民主共和國為多;WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
te-55ufcQ2ClxQUbcfUTeA.en: WHO reports that globally, as of July this year, about 380,000 cases and 4,478 deaths have been cumulatively reported. In July alone, about 68,000 new cases and 624 deaths were reported, a 14% increase over June. Case fatality rates across countries range from 0–11.2%. Cases are distributed across 31 countries and regions in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean, South-East Asia and the Americas, with the most in South Sudan, Afghanistan, Yemen and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO estimates that about one billion people are at risk of infection, and assesses the global transmission risk as very high.

JJ420vWXagCIspeEq_2CuA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至6月累計報告近30.6萬例,3,522例死亡,其中,6月新增報告約6.2萬例、死亡527例,較5月下降21%,各國CFR介於0-8.1%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞共28個國家/地區,以南蘇丹、葉門、阿富汗、及剛果民主共和國為多;目前全球口服霍亂疫苗緊急應變庫存290萬劑,低於安全水平(500萬劑),估計約有10億人口面臨感染風險,評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
JJ420vWXagCIspeEq_2CuA.en: WHO reports that as of June this year, nearly 306,000 cases and 3,522 deaths have been reported globally. In June alone, about 62,000 new cases and 527 deaths were reported, a 21% decrease from May. Case fatality ratios range from 0 to 8.1% across countries. Cases were distributed across 28 countries and territories in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia, with the most in South Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The global emergency stockpile of oral cholera vaccine currently stands at 2.9 million doses, below the safe threshold of 5 million doses. An estimated 1 billion people face a risk of infection, and WHO assesses the global transmission risk as very high.

ZHzd-mzUJarmrshwLG_NQQ.zh: WHO更新非洲25國疫情,其中,南蘇丹第25週(6/16-22)新增673例病例,其中4例死亡,病患以5歲以下兒童為多(25%),WHO評估疫情風險仍高,雖口服疫苗接種計畫持續進行,惟戰亂衝突導致衛生環境不佳、延遲就醫及高死亡率。
ZHzd-mzUJarmrshwLG_NQQ.en: WHO has updated the situation in 25 African countries. In South Sudan, 673 new cases were reported in week 25 (16–22 June), including 4 deaths. Children under 5 accounted for 25% of cases. WHO assesses the risk as still high. Although oral vaccination campaigns continue, conflict has led to poor sanitation, delayed care and high mortality.

HDUdgM7O3CKOUbza69lsFA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至4月累計報告已達157,035例,2,148例死亡,其中,4月報告逾3.7萬例病例(死亡561例),較今年3月增加5%,各國CFR介於0-5.3%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞共18個國家/地區,以阿富汗、南蘇丹及剛果民主共和國為多,目前全球口服霍亂疫苗緊急應變庫存360萬劑,低於安全水平(500萬劑),估計約有10億人口面臨感染風險,評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
HDUdgM7O3CKOUbza69lsFA.en: WHO reports that as of April this year, 157,035 cases and 2,148 deaths have been reported cumulatively worldwide. In April alone, more than 37,000 cases (561 deaths) were reported, a 5% increase from March this year, with CFRs between 0 and 5.3% across countries. Cases are distributed across 18 countries and regions in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia, mainly in Afghanistan, South Sudan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The global emergency stockpile of oral cholera vaccine currently stands at 3.6 million doses, below the safety level of 5 million doses. An estimated 1 billion people face a risk of infection. The global transmission risk is assessed as very high.

9EW7rYzI9WlgEJDXbGbiXQ.zh: WHO於4/22公布全球今年迄3月累計報告11萬6,574例病例,1,514例死亡,其中,3月份報告近3萬3,000例病例,517例死亡(CFR:1.6%),較2月病例/死亡數分別下降9%及8%。病患分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞區域共22個國家,新增病例數以南蘇丹(7,709例)、阿富汗(7,130例)及剛果民主共和國(5,679例)等為多,WHO評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
9EW7rYzI9WlgEJDXbGbiXQ.en: WHO reported on 22 April that globally, as of March this year, 116,574 cases and 1,514 deaths had been reported cumulatively. In March alone, nearly 33,000 cases and 517 deaths were reported (CFR 1.6%), a decrease of 9% in cases and 8% in deaths compared with February. Cases are distributed across 22 countries in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia. The largest numbers of new cases were in South Sudan (7,709), Afghanistan (7,130) and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (5,679). WHO assesses the global transmission risk as very high.

2_A4GUDc_g9TIDBANWajNg.zh: WHO於2/7公布南蘇丹新增1例I型病例、141例疑病例,指標病例為烏干達國民、該國居民,2/6確診,該國成為第22個非洲疫區國家。 愛爾蘭於2/6報告新增首例Ib型病例,具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,個案刻正接受治療,當局已匡列接觸者,評估一般民眾風險仍為低。
2_A4GUDc_g9TIDBANWajNg.en: WHO announced on 7 February that South Sudan had reported 1 clade I case and 141 suspected cases. The index case is a Ugandan national and resident of South Sudan, confirmed on 6 February; the country became the 22nd African country with outbreaks. Ireland reported its first clade Ib case on 6 February. The patient has a travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and is under treatment. Authorities have listed contacts and assess the risk to the general public as still low.

vJs3_0ExWQtiyOi_splGpg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/1-1/8期間,巴基斯坦報告新增1例WPV1型病例;共2國新增4例cVDPV2型病例,分別為奈及利亞3例、印1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增13件WPV1型陽性樣本;英國新增1例cVDPV2型陽性樣本。 2024年全年病例數,其中奈及利亞累計93例cVDPV2型,巴基斯坦累計報告68例WPV1型,剛果民主共和國累計9例cVDPV1與14例cVDPV2型,印累計7例cVDPV2型,南蘇丹10例cVDPV2 型。
vJs3_0ExWQtiyOi_splGpg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 1–8 January, Pakistan reported one new WPV1 case. Two countries reported four new cVDPV2 cases: three in Nigeria and one in Indonesia. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 13 new WPV1-positive samples, and the United Kingdom reported one new cVDPV2-positive sample. Full-year 2024 case counts: Nigeria cumulatively reported 93 cVDPV2 cases; Pakistan 68 WPV1 cases; the Democratic Republic of the Congo 9 cVDPV1 and 14 cVDPV2 cases; Indonesia 7 cVDPV2 cases; and South Sudan 10 cVDPV2 cases.

cySKfmVQceei8CFrRSvb3w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於去年12/19-12/31期間,巴基斯坦報告新增3例WPV1型病例;共2國新增3例cVDPV2,分別為剛果民主共和國2例、南蘇丹1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增52件WPV1型陽性樣本;共3國新增6件cVDPV2型陽性樣本,分別為象牙海岸4件、阿爾及利亞/波蘭各1件。 2024年巴基斯坦累計報告WPV1型67例,剛果民主共和國累計WPV1型9例與cVDPV2型14例,南蘇丹cVDPV2 型10例。
cySKfmVQceei8CFrRSvb3w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 19–31 December last year, Pakistan reported three new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported three new cVDPV2 cases: two in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and one in South Sudan. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 52 new WPV1-positive samples. Three countries reported six new cVDPV2-positive samples: four in Côte d'Ivoire, and one each in Algeria and Poland. For 2024, Pakistan cumulatively reported 67 WPV1 cases; the Democratic Republic of the Congo cumulatively reported 9 WPV1 cases and 14 cVDPV2 cases; and South Sudan reported 10 cVDPV2 cases.

ALtO__tag2swj8Yyk1f-TQ.zh: 東非蘇丹疫情嚴峻,去年12/3已知感染病例達48,000例,其中18%正在接受治療,另12/23報載南蘇丹瓊萊州產前檢查陽性孕婦人數亦明顯上升,推測社會動盪及缺乏醫療資源應為當地疫情上升主因;烏干達去年全國盛行率約5.1%,其中,卡蘭加拉區較為嚴峻,盛行率約12.8%,惟近年已有明顯下降。
ALtO__tag2swj8Yyk1f-TQ.en: The HIV situation in Sudan in East Africa is severe: as of 3 December 2024, 48,000 known infections had been recorded, and 18% of them were receiving treatment. Media reported on 23 December that the number of pregnant women testing positive at antenatal screening in Jonglei State, South Sudan, had also risen markedly. The rise is presumed to be mainly due to social unrest and a lack of medical resources. Uganda's national prevalence in 2024 was about 5.1%; Kalangala District is more severe, with a prevalence of about 12.8%, although it has declined markedly in recent years.

AdEEOhlIAriIvuJj5XJKmw.zh: 非洲疫情更新,2024年截至11/30累計1,138例病例,其中41例確診,7例死亡,病例分布於剛果 (452例)、中非共和國(390例)、加彭(146例)、南蘇丹(139例)、喀麥隆(8例)、幾內亞(2例)及烏干達(1例)。
AdEEOhlIAriIvuJj5XJKmw.en: Africa epidemic update: As of 30 November 2024, 1,138 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 41 confirmed and 7 deaths. Cases were distributed as follows: Republic of the Congo (452), Central African Republic (390), Gabon (146), South Sudan (139), Cameroon (8), Guinea (2) and Uganda (1).

GpgpR5XCis2pppE1wg2n8Q.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至11/24累計33國報告733,000餘例病例及逾5,000例死亡;分別較去年同期增加37%及27%,病例數以東地中海區、非洲區及東南亞區為多,地區性戰爭衝突、自然災害等因素降低醫療服務資源可近性並加劇爆發疫情,WHO於11月通過審查新疫苗配方及生產流程,疫苗產量達2013年以來新高,以應付目前疫苗短缺之情況,評估全球疫情風險仍為非常高。 非洲地區今年截至12/21累計報告逾219,000例及3,500餘例死亡(CFR: 1.6%),南蘇丹於10月下旬宣布爆發疫情,迄今累計4,700餘例及47例死亡(CFR: 0.9%);蘇丹今年迄今累計49,000餘例及892例死亡(CFR: 1.8%),兩國近期受人道危機及天災影響,疫情持續擴大;迦納、莫三比克、坦尚亞及辛巴威持續報告病例。
GpgpR5XCis2pppE1wg2n8Q.en: WHO reported that globally as of 24 November this year, 33 countries had reported over 733,000 cases and over 5,000 deaths, increases of 37% and 27% respectively over the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in the Eastern Mediterranean, African and South-East Asian regions. Regional wars and conflicts, and natural disasters, have reduced access to health services and aggravated outbreaks. WHO approved a review of a new vaccine formulation and production process in November, and vaccine output reached its highest level since 2013 to address the current vaccine shortage. The global outbreak risk is still assessed as very high. In Africa, as of 21 December this year, over 219,000 cases and over 3,500 deaths (CFR 1.6%) had been reported cumulatively. South Sudan declared an outbreak in late October; to date, over 4,700 cases and 47 deaths (CFR 0.9%) have been recorded. Sudan has recorded over 49,000 cases and 892 deaths (CFR 1.8%) this year. Both countries are affected by humanitarian crises and natural disasters, and their outbreaks continue to expand. Ghana, Mozambique, Tanzania and Zimbabwe continue to report cases.

F5sIzm5Rr4eGoqfgVv6TEA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 12/12-12/18期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共2國新增7例cVDPV2,分別為查德4例、奈及利亞3例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增8件WPV1陽性樣本;共8國新增23件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為德國7件、英國5件、奈及利亞/南蘇丹各3 件、查德2件、喀麥隆/象牙海岸/芬蘭各1件。 澳洲墨爾本於汙水中檢出VDPV2陽性樣本,經檢測可能與海外接種小兒麻痺活性疫苗人員相關,並於維多利亞州境內持續散播,當局表示當地疫苗接種率高且汙水經有效處理,評估傳播風險為低。
F5sIzm5Rr4eGoqfgVv6TEA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 12–18 December, Pakistan reported four new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported seven new cVDPV2 cases: four in Chad and three in Nigeria. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported eight new WPV1-positive samples. Eight countries reported 23 new cVDPV2-positive samples: seven in Germany, five in the United Kingdom, three each in Nigeria and South Sudan, two in Chad, and one each in Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire and Finland. In Australia, VDPV2-positive samples were detected in wastewater in Melbourne. Testing suggests they may be linked to personnel who received live oral polio vaccine overseas, and the virus continues to spread within Victoria State. Authorities state that vaccination coverage in the area is high and wastewater is effectively treated, and they assess the transmission risk as low.

n5ruCKVAlCF_5-iguxghdg.zh: 南蘇丹疫情更新,近3個月該國西北部阿維爾之兒童病例數呈上升趨勢,6-9月每週報告約400例病例,較去年同期為高,當局推動疫苗接種及相關防治措施,希望能控制疫情。
n5ruCKVAlCF_5-iguxghdg.en: South Sudan epidemic update: Over the past three months, child malaria cases in Aweil, in the north-west of the country, have shown an upward trend. From June to September, about 400 cases were reported each week, higher than the same period last year. Authorities are promoting vaccination and related control measures, hoping to bring the outbreak under control.

NdTbNjqsO2mpAriVJxOaMw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 11/14-11/20期間,巴基斯坦新增1例WPV1病例;共2國新增6例cVDPV2病例,其中查德5例、奈及利亞1例。環境樣本部分,共2國新增7件WPV1陽性樣本,分別為阿富汗6件、巴基斯坦1件;共3國新增3件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為查德/波蘭/南蘇丹各1件。 波蘭於11/18報告該國檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本,係自該國首都華沙10/22之廢水樣本中檢出,當地迄無報告病例。經分析顯示,該病毒與奈及利亞北部疫情相關,近期亦於西班牙被檢測到。
NdTbNjqsO2mpAriVJxOaMw.en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 14 and 20 November, Pakistan added 1 WPV1 case. A total of 2 countries added 6 cVDPV2 cases: Chad 5 and Nigeria 1. For environmental samples, 2 countries added 7 WPV1-positive samples: Afghanistan 6 and Pakistan 1. A total of 3 countries added 3 cVDPV2-positive samples: Chad, Poland and South Sudan, 1 each.

Poland reported on 18 November that cVDPV2-positive samples had been detected in the country, from wastewater samples collected in the capital, Warsaw, on 22 October. No cases have been reported locally. Analysis shows that the virus is related to the outbreak in northern Nigeria, and it has also recently been detected in Spain.

yREe2dxQr61YyDwizL7Oaw.zh: 南蘇丹今年迄今累計報告至少162例病例,其中3例死亡(CFR:1.9%),病患以壯年人口及男性為多,均有食用病死動物肉接觸史,並出現發燒、皮膚潰瘍等症狀,分布集中於該國西南部西加札爾河州及瓦拉卜州。另該國今年迄今已有36,861隻動物感染該疾病。
yREe2dxQr61YyDwizL7Oaw.en: South Sudan has cumulatively reported at least 162 cases this year so far, including 3 deaths (CFR: 1.9%). Patients are mostly working-age adults and men, all with a history of eating meat from dead animals, and presented with fever, skin ulcers and other symptoms. Cases are concentrated in Western Bahr el Ghazal State and Warrap State in the southwest of the country. In addition, 36,861 animals have been infected with the disease in the country so far this year.

fzu8i1b55w9en5N7qSG6ig.zh: 越南南部胡志明市疫情持續嚴峻,截至10/13累計報告達1,079例,其中4例死亡,5成病例為5歲以下兒童,該市已透過學校系統加強兒童免疫覆蓋率;該國北部清化省10月初亦爆發疫情,單週新增近40例病例,近7成病例為5歲以下兒童,多數病例未接種疫苗或接種史不明。 西非象牙海岸今年截至10/14累計報告1,287例確診病例,病患多為9歲以下兒童,近9成未接種疫苗或接種史不明;該國前3年病例數約介於1,300至2,000例間。 東非南蘇丹南部瓦拉卜州宣布爆發疫情,截至10/22累計報告88例確診病例,當局已加強疫苗接種。
fzu8i1b55w9en5N7qSG6ig.en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City in southern Viet Nam, the outbreak remains severe. As of 13 October, 1,079 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 4 deaths. About half of cases are children under 5 years old, and the city has strengthened children's immunization coverage through the school system. In Thanh Hoa Province in northern Viet Nam, an outbreak also began in early October, with nearly 40 new cases in a single week; nearly 70% of cases are children under 5, and most cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history.

Côte d'Ivoire, in West Africa: As of 14 October this year, 1,287 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, mostly children under 9 years old; nearly 90% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. The country's case numbers in the previous three years ranged from about 1,300 to 2,000.

South Sudan, in East Africa: Warrap State in southern South Sudan has announced an outbreak. As of 22 October, 88 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, and authorities have strengthened vaccination.

RAZen0Fms8bDx5DZg8eh3g.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/3-10/9期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共3國新增6例cVDPV2病例,分別為奈及利亞4例、安哥拉/南蘇丹各1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增50件WPV1陽性樣本;共4國新增8件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為日4件、南蘇丹2件、西班牙/葉門各1件;法屬圭亞那新增3件cVDPV3陽性樣本。 全球今年WPV1病例累計50例,其中巴基斯坦28例、阿富汗22例,疾病仍持續傳播並造成兒童健康風險。
RAZen0Fms8bDx5DZg8eh3g.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 3 and 9 October, Pakistan recorded 4 new WPV1 cases. Across 3 countries, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported: Nigeria 4, and Angola and South Sudan 1 each. For environmental samples, Pakistan recorded 50 new WPV1-positive samples. Across 4 countries, 8 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported: Japan 4, South Sudan 2, and Spain and Yemen 1 each. French Guiana recorded 3 new cVDPV3-positive samples. Globally this year, cumulative WPV1 cases total 50, including 28 in Pakistan and 22 in Afghanistan. The disease continues to spread and poses health risks to children.
